name: HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP
description:
HireOtto is a hosted Google Analytics 4 (GA4) MCP server for Claude that brings acquisition, engagement and conversion analysis into the same AI workflow marketers use for advertising and measurement.

Discover accessible Analytics accounts and GA4 properties, inspect property configuration, data streams, key events, Google Ads links, custom dimensions and custom metrics, then run standard or custom reports using the dimensions and metrics available to that property. HireOtto can check field compatibility before a report runs, compare time periods, analyze acquisition by source, medium and campaign, investigate landing-page outcomes, query recent activity with GA4 realtime reporting and export larger result sets to CSV.

The GA4 connector is intentionally read-only. It supports analysis and measurement QA without allowing the AI client to edit properties, data streams, key events, links, custom definitions or other GA4 settings.

What sets HireOtto apart is the broader performance-marketing context around the Analytics data. The same HireOtto subscription also includes Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console, so marketers can investigate what happened after an ad click alongside campaign, tagging and organic-search context rather than treating Analytics as an isolated reporting dashboard.

Pricing is simple and usage-based rather than tied to ad spend or the number of advertising accounts managed. Starter and Pro use monthly credits, while Agency includes unlimited usage and multiple connected profiles. Paid plans allow unlimited supported platforms, ad accounts and managed spend.

HireOtto is fully hosted and uses OAuth. Users do not need to create a Google Cloud project, enable Analytics APIs, download credential files, manage API keys or run a local MCP server.

Google Analytics is currently available in beta while HireOtto continues to expand guided analysis, cross-platform measurement reviews and ready-made reporting workflows.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ga4.hireotto.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP provides these MCP tools: authenticate_ga4, check_ga4_compatibility, get_billing_status, get_ga4_metadata, get_ga4_property_configuration, list_ga4_accounts_properties, run_ga4_realtime_report, and run_ga4_report.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: HireOtto - Google Analytics MCP is developed by HireOtto. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
